chunks.text: Been a long week. I was glancing at my card stuff and realized I haven’t checked the balance on that account in ages—6222021234567890.
Also, I’ll be in Beijing soon and it’d be fun to catch a movie one night… I’m kind of curious what’s even playing around there.
If something decent lines up, I’m leaning toward The Wandering Earth 3.
And yeah, if it’s at Wanda Cinema CBD at 21:50, that actually works—go ahead and lock in 2 seats under Sun Lei.
Right, and the ticket should be under the buyer name Sun Lei—so if you’re booking it, that’s the name to use.
Switching gears—next week I’m in Nanjing, and it’d be nice to just have a simple lunch spot sorted without overthinking it.

Actually yeah, let’s just reserve Lao Men Dong Restaurant for 2026-04-25 at 12:00, party of 1—put it under Olivia Brown, phone 13813897597. Oh, and I’ve been meaning to finally start a course too; if Data Science Fundamentals is available, go ahead and enroll Hu Bin.
